title: Sister Neon
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: Layered supersaw chords sweep open on an OberheimDMX four-to-the-floor kick, building from a hazy atmospheric intro through a driving bass and square-wave melody peak. The arrangement moves through a stripped breakdown with triangle arpeggios before the final chorus doubles the chord rate and lets the filter climb to a bright, euphoric climax.
